concerns.text: The validation strategy uses recent occurrence records (2005‑2020) both to evaluate historic‑trained models and as the ground‑truth for assessing future (2050) projections (see Research §2). This creates a circular/tautological validation: the same dataset serves as the dependent variable for both the historic performance baseline and the future‑projection performance assessment, yet the hypothesis being tested is precisely whether niche suitability changes over time. Using recent records to judge future projections assumes niche stability, which is the null hypothesis, making the test unable to independently confirm or refute niche shift.
